title: AES-GCM decrypt: authTagSz=0 skips tag validation silently
description: In crypto2dev_cipher(), the SET_TAG ioctl is guarded by 'authTagSz > 0 && authTagSz <= CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN'. When authTagSz == 0 (or > CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN), SET_TAG is skipped entirely and decryption proceeds. For the zero-length case, the device decrypts without any authentication check. The caller sees ret=0 as if decryption succeeded with a valid tag. A caller supplying authTagSz=0 gets unauthenticated GCM decrypt silently passing instead of a hard error.
